item.title: Cottage cheese sold at Walmart in 24 states, including Nevada, is recalled
item.description: Cottage cheese sold at Walmart stores in 24 state is being recalled over concerns that liquid dairy ingredients used in the items may not being fully pasteurized, according to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
